body: Forge Sword Repair mandate received (6 files + instruction), read and archived. Progress so far, executing your stated priority order: P0 #3 (log overwrite) is FULLY FIXED -- TLog() was using FILE_WRITE alone, which truncates the file on every single call (confirmed: the live log only ever held its most recent line, never a growing history). Fixed with the same FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE pattern this project already used for WARRANT#104, plus a bounded ~5MB rotation since this file has no other reset point across a long EA lifetime. Shipped as WARRANT#147/SLS(129), 0/0 compile, diff-confined to 3 hunks. P0 #2 (dual scorer) is DIAGNOSED, not yet fixed -- traced every CalculateScoreWithWeights call site and found the real shape is bigger than described: 10 call sites (not 1 seam), plus Phase 3.5 has a THIRD, entirely separate hand-rolled scoring path (EvalP35Weights/ssc0-5) that calls neither named scorer. Filed as WARRANT#148, a precise open hypothesis with the full site list on record, rather than rushing a find-replace across 10+ sites in one pass -- several of those sites may be intentionally using a simplified/neutral scorer for isolated diagnostic measurement, not a genuine calibration-vs-live mismatch, and this project has been burned before by rushed multi-site scoring changes (SLS(35) CRITICAL1/5 lineage). Current head is SLS(130)/10.44, forward-only from the mandate's stated 127 base (128/129/130 shipped in between: cross-regime pooling WARRANT#146, then this mandate's two P0 items). All 3 EA locations in sync, ledger updated through pass_121. A live run (SLS128, now effectively testing 130's logic too since only comment/logging changes came after) is in progress in parallel -- r1 Strong Bull already showing 70-77% WR / 83% val across its stages. Continuing down the priority list (items #1, #4-10) next. Will keep sending progress.
